passives.name: Dujeong Brigandine [Sal] - Great Mountain
passives.text:
hint=2|Take -30% damage from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, Sinking (rounded down) 
 Gain the effects of Fixed Panic; If this unit is Panicked at Turn End, reset SP to 45 
 Turn Start: Gain the following effects: 
 - When in Battleform of the Homeland - Bearhunt: At less than 5 Swordplay of the Homeland -Sal- Stack, gain (5 - Swordplay of the Homeland -Sal- Stack)  
 - When in Battleform of the Homeland - Tigerhunt: At more than 5 Swordplay of the Homeland -Sal- Stack, gain  equal to surplus Swordplay of the Homeland -Sal- Stack past 5|flavor=The three Court Circles of Sal, Pi, and Ppyeo each remade the standard Dujeong Brigandine of S Corp. into forms suited to their own doctrines. 
 The olden tales say that the "Sal" has ever been the first to spearhead a slaughter, eager to cleave the enemy's flesh before any other. 
 The "Pi" harvests the blood that spills forth from each opened flesh wound and turns it into endurance on the battlefield. 
 The "Ppyeo" takes the close of a slaughter. They part one joint from the other, bringing the enemy to their knees. Then, a blade through the neckbone finishes the collective act of killing.

 On Hit using a Slash Skill, gain 1 Poise Potency (once per Skill)

 - Turn after Stagger 
 - When in Low Morale or Panic

 If this unit used the "Bow of the Homeland - Arrowloose" Skill in the last turn, use a powerful Skill regardless of Swordplay of the Homeland -Sal- Stack on self 
 At 55% or lower HP, use a powerful Skill regardless of Swordplay of the Homeland -Sal- Stack on self|flavor=The Sword of the Homeland passed down in the Sal Court Circle is not, at its heart, an art of killing. 
 To cut and cut again until blood runs dry and the bone is laid bare—that is the essence of this art that strips the opponent's flesh into ribbons. 
 That is the Sword of the Homeland practiced by "Sal."
